browserAcceptance.scope: isolated Chromium HTTPS cookie and callback acceptance
browserAcceptance.certificateTrust: exact test SPKI pin; independent CA checks run separately
browserAcceptance.scopeLimit: Only identity, real cookie handling, callback, context persistence and logout. Positive browser uses exact test SPKI; independent clients validate the CA chain. No public DNS/CA or full business-UI acceptance.

earlierFailedAttempts: First full backend rehearsal completed, but Playwright expected an unavailable bundled browser; not counted as full acceptance. Explicit existing Chrome then passed focused and final full rehearsals.
LibreSSL expired-certificate fixture uses explicit historical dates rather than negative days.
limitations: Ports remain loopback-only; target public DNS, CA, firewall and device trust not accepted
No automatic certificate issuance or renewal; historical private generations remain in protected backups
No physical power-loss acceptance; filesystem fault paths covered by unit tests
No cross-host/engine/architecture conversion, arbitrary schema migration, historical identity/data conversion, full business UI or optional-module release acceptance
No complete inherited-source security/license audit or public release
